message.content:
Below is a quick‑look calendar of the **long weekends** that Canadians can expect in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday, or is observed on a Monday when it lands on a weekend.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes / Observed | Province/territory coverage |
|---------|---------|------------------|-----------------------------|
| **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day (Sunday) | Observed on Monday, Jan 2 | All of Canada |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Ontario, BC, AB, NB, PEI, SK) | Observed on Monday, Feb 20 | Ontario, BC, AB, NB, PEI, SK |
| **Apr 7–10** | Good Friday & Easter Monday (some provinces) | Good Friday (Friday) + Easter Monday (Monday) | BC, AB, MB, NB, PEI, SK, NL, NT, YT |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day (Mon) | Observed on Monday, May 22 | All of Canada |
| **Jul 3–5** | Canada Day (Sat) – observed on Monday, Jul 3 | Observed on Monday, Jul 3 | All of Canada |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day (Mon) | Observed on Monday, Sep 4 | All of Canada |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving (Mon) | Observed on Monday, Oct 9 | All of Canada |
| **Dec 24–26** | Christmas (Mon) + Boxing Day (Tue) | Observed on Monday, Dec 25 & Tuesday, Dec 26 | All of Canada |

### How to use this in your app

1. **Create a date range** for each long weekend (start date to end date).  
2. **Tag the holiday names** so users can see why the weekend is extended.  
3. **Add a flag for “observed”** if the holiday is officially moved to a Monday (e.g., Canada Day 2023).  
4. **Filter by province** if you want to show only the holidays that apply to a specific region.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the data in a different format (JSON, CSV, etc.) or if you need the list for a different year!
